Gary Lineker introduces highlights of Saturday's Premier League action, including a Manchester derby between United and City. Pep Guardiola's side embarrassed their neighbours with a 6-3 victory in October, but Erik ten Hag has since steadied the ship at Old Trafford and will hope to record a first home league win against City since March 2020.

eps.t: The FA Cup MOTD Live: Wolverhampton Wanderers v Liverpool
eps.d: Live and exclusive coverage from the FA Cup as Wolverhampton Wanderers and Liverpool get another chance to book their place in the fourth round of the famous competition. Replays return to the competition this season for the first time since 2020 after the FA removed them to ease fixture congestion during the pandemic.

Gary Lineker presents highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Liverpool v Chelsea and Crystal Palace v Newcastle United. Plus, Bournemouth v Nottingham Forest, Leicester City v Brighton & Hove Albion, Southampton v Aston Villa and West Ham United v Everton.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fourth Round: Accrington Stanley v Leeds United
eps.d: Live coverage of the FA Cup fourth-round tie between Accrington Stanley and Leeds United.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fourth Round: Preston North End v Tottenham Hotspur
eps.d: Gary Lineker presents all the action from the fourth-round tie at Deepdale between Preston North End v Tottenham Hotspur. With analysis from Alan Shearer and Micah Richards.

All the goals and highlights from the FA Cup fourth-round ties that have taken place so far this weekend, including Manchester City's game against Arsenal on Friday. The magic of the cup was alive and kicking last year as non-league Boreham Wood knocked out Bournemouth to reach the fifth round, while Kidderminster Harriers took West Ham to extra time.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fourth Round: Wrexham v Sheffield United
eps.d: Gary Lineker presents all the action from the fourth-round tie at the Racecourse Ground between Wrexham v Sheffield United.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights of the latest round of Premier League games, including the clash between Everton and title hopefuls Arsenal at Goodison Park. The Gunners have failed to win any of their last four matches away to the Merseysiders, including a 2-1 defeat last season, when Demarai Gray scored a last-minute winner for the Toffees.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fourth-Round Replay: Sunderland v Fulham
eps.d: Live coverage of the fourth-round replay between Sunderland and Fulham.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights of the latest round of Premier League matches, including the all-London clash between West Ham United and Chelsea. Elsewhere, Crystal Palace host fierce rivals Brighton, Tottenham travel to Leicester City, and Eddie Howe's Newcastle head south to face his former club Bournemouth.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights of the latest round of Premier League matches, including Liverpool's trip to St James' Park to face Eddie Howe's Newcastle United. Jurgen Klopp's side inflicted the Magpies first league defeat of the season back in August, winning 2-1 at Anfield thanks to a 90th minute winner from young forward Fabio Carvalho.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights of the latest round of Premier League matches, with Arsenal, Liverpool and Manchester City all in action. Arsenal travel to Leicester City, who they beat 4-2 in August, a month which saw them win all of their first five league games of the season. Manchester City make the journey to Bournemouth, who they thrashed 4-0 in their opening home game of this campaign.

eps.d: Coverage of Chelsea v Arsenal from the fifth round of the Women's FA Cup.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fifth Round: Fulham v Leeds United
eps.d: Live coverage from Craven Cottage of the FA Cup fifth-round clash between Fulham and Leeds United, two of the most entertaining teams in the top flight. The teams reached this stage in very different fashion, with Leeds cruising past Accrington Stanley in the fourth round, while Fulham needed a replay to see off Championship side Sunderland.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fifth Round: Sheffield United v Tottenham Hotspur
eps.d: Live coverage from Bramall Lane as Championship side Sheffield United aim to cause an upset against Premier League Tottenham Hotspur.

Gary Lineker presents highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Manchester City v Newcastle United at Etihad Stadium and Arsenal v Bournemouth at Emirates Stadium. The Citizens and Newcastle shared the spoils in a thrilling 3-3 draw at St James' Park in August, but the champions will have hoped to make home advantage count this time around.

Highlights of the latest round of Premier League matches with Manchester City, Tottenham and Liverpool all in action. City were bidding to keep their title bid on track when they travelled to Crystal Palace, while Tottenham hosted Nottingham Forest, and Liverpool faced Bournemouth. Plus all the goals from Saturday's other fixtures.

eps.t: The FA Cup Quarter-Final: Manchester City v Burnley
eps.d: City legend Vincent Kompany brings his Burnley side to the Etihad, looking to upset Pep Guardiola's Premier League champions.

Mark Chapman introduces all the highlights and talking points from the latest round of Premier League fixtures, including Leicester's trip to Brentford. The two sides met on the opening day of the season, with the Bees fighting back from two goals down to salvage a draw, thanks to goals from Ivan Toney and Josh Dasilva.

eps.t: The FA Cup Quarter-Final: Brighton & Hove Albion v Grimsby Town
eps.d: Live and exclusive FA Cup action as Premier League Brighton host League Two Grimsby in the quarter-finals.

eps.t: Under-21 2023 England U21 v Croatia U21
eps.d: Live coverage as England's under-21 side take on their Croatian counterparts in a friendly at Fulham's Craven Cottage. The under-21s, coached by Lee Carsley, are preparing for this summer's European Championship, to be held in Romania and Georgia. Fellow finalists Croatia should provide high-quality opposition for the Young Lions.

Mark Chapman presents highlights of the latest Premier League fixtures, including Manchester City v Liverpool at Etihad Stadium and Arsenal v Leeds United at Emirates Stadium. The Citizens were looking to avenge a 1-0 defeat at Anfield against an inconsistent Liverpool side, while fellow title-challengers Arsenal will have expected three points against struggling Leeds.

Highlights from all the midweek Premier League fixtures, including Liverpool's visit to Stamford Bridge to face Chelsea. Manchester United hosted Brentford, hoping to avenge the 4-0 drubbing they had at the hands of the Bees in August. Struggling Bournemouth faced south-coast rivals Brighton, who have enjoyed a successful first season under Roberto De Zerbi.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights and analysis of the day's eight Premier League games, including Manchester United v Everton and Spurs against surprise top-four rivals Brighton. Manchester United had already earned league and FA Cup victories this season against Everton, who have continued to struggle away from home since Sean Dyche was appointed as manager in January.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights and analysis of seven Premier League games, including title-chasing Manchester City's clash with relegation-threatened Leicester. The defending champions are locked in a two-way battle for the title with Arsenal, while the visitors are enduring a difficult campaign at the wrong end of the table under manager Brendan Rodgers.

eps.t: Women's FA Cup Aston Villa v Chelsea
eps.d: Watch live coverage as Aston Villa take on Chelsea in the Women's FA Cup semi-finals.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights and analysis of today's Premier League games, including the crucial clash between Leicester City and Wolves. Both clubs have endured difficult campaigns at the wrong end of the table, and a result for either side would go a long way to securing their Premier League status ahead of next season.

eps.t: The FA Cup Semi-Final: Brighton & Hove Albion v Manchester United
eps.d: Gary Lineker introduces the FA Cup semi-final between high-flying Brighton & Hove Albion and Premier League heavyweights Manchester United from Wembley. It's been 40 years since the Seagulls last soared to this stage of the competition, and they went on to face Manchester United in the final that season. Brighton were soundly beaten 4-0 in a replay by United after the first match finished 2-2.

Gary Lineker presents highlights of the midweek Premier League fixtures, including title-chasing Arsenal's trip to face defending champions Manchester City. The Gunners have already suffered defeat at the Etihad this season in the FA Cup, and haven't won away at City in any competition since a 2-0 top-flight victory in 2015.

Gary Lineker is joined by Alan Shearer and Jermaine Jenas to present highlights of the latest Premier League matches, featuring Brighton & Hove Albion v Wolverhampton Wanderers, Crystal Palace v West Ham United at Selhurst Park and Brentford v Nottingham Forest at Gtech Community Stadium.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights of today's Premier League games, including Liverpool's clash with Brentford. It's been a topsy-turvy season for Jürgen Klopp's Reds, and they now face a tough test against Thomas Frank's Brentford side, who continue to punch above their weight and boast the prolific Ivan Toney in their ranks.

Gary Lineker and guests review highlights from Saturday's Premier League fixtures, including vital games at both ends of the table. Aston Villa hosted Tottenham in a match that could have repercussions for the European places, while other key games saw Newcastle travel to Leeds and Manchester United welcome Wolves to Old Trafford.

Gary Lineker presents highlights of the day's Premier League games, including relegation-threatened sides Nottingham Forest and Everton's matches against Arsenal and Wolves. Arsenal thrashed Forest 5-0 in October's reverse fixture to return to the top of the Premier League table, but indifferent results last month culminated in the Gunners' damaging defeat by title rivals Manchester City.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights of the final day of the 2022/23 Premier League season, with plenty still to be decided in England's top division. At the summit, Arsenal bring down the curtain on their outstanding season by hosting Wolves, while Manchester City travel to Brentford, who won 2-1 at the Etihad in November.

eps.t: The FA Cup 2022/23 Final: Manchester City v Manchester United
eps.d: Manchester City meet local rivals Manchester United in a blockbuster contest at Wembley as football's oldest cup competition reaches its exhilarating climax. The two Manchester clubs have met 188 times in all competitions but never before in an FA Cup final. City have won the competition most recently, lifting the trophy for a sixth time after defeating Watford four years ago.

eps.t: The FA Cup 2022/23 Final Highlights: Manchester City v Manchester United
eps.d: Watch the best of the action from Wembley as Manchester City take on Manchester United for the first time in an FA Cup final. Six-time winners City hope to add to their trophy haul under manager Pep Guardiola after getting knocked out in last season's semi-finals, while United aim to add to their League Cup triumph earlier in this campaign and equal Arsenal's record of 13 FA Cup wins.

Last season's runners-up Arsenal invested heavily in the summer on the likes of Declan Rice and Kai Havertz, and will have expected to get off to a winning start.

Gary Lineker presents highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Tottenham Hotspur v Manchester United at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium and Manchester City v Newcastle United at Etihad Stadium. Spurs and United shared the spoils in an entertaining 2-2 draw in last season's corresponding fixture, and the Citizens claimed a 2-0 win at home to the Magpies.

Gary Lineker presents highlights and analysis of the latest round of Premier League games, with Manchester United hosting Nottingham Forest and West Ham travelling to Brighton. The Red Devils have won their previous ten meetings with Forest in league and cup, scoring 36 goals and conceding just three during that run.

After a run of nine matches without a win against the Seagulls, Newcastle have won two of their last three meetings, including a thumping 4-1 victory at St James' Park at the end of last season.

Last season's champions Manchester City are at Wolves, who they beat 3-0 home and away last season. Tottenham host Liverpool, a match-up which produced 10 goals in the two meetings in 2022-23.

Gary Lineker presents highlights and analysis of the latest round of Premier League games, with Luton Town hosting Tottenham Hotspur and Manchester United welcoming Brentford. It's been more than 31 years since Tottenham and Luton have met in a competitive fixture, and the Lilywhites are unbeaten in the previous nine clashes, winning five and drawing four.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights and analysis of Saturday's Premier League games, as Arsenal take on Sheffield United and Chelsea host Brentford in a west London derby. At the Emirates, Mikel Arteta's Arsenal are aiming to protect an unbeaten home record against Sheffield United that dates back to 1971.

Gary Lineker presents highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Manchester City v Bournemouth at Etihad Stadium and Newcastle United v Arsenal at St James' Park. Champions City will have expected to claim three points against the struggling Cherries, while the Gunners were looking to emulate their 2-0 triumph away to Newcastle last term.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights and analysis of the day's Premier League games as Arsenal take on Burnley and Wolves host Tottenham in the early kick-off. Burnley are unbeaten in their previous two visits to the Emirates, winning one and drawing one without conceding a goal. The Gunners have scored just twice in their past five top-flight meetings with the Clarets.

Gary Lineker presents highlights from the day's Premier League games, including Liverpool's visit to the Etihad Stadium to face champions Manchester City. Arsenal had a London derby date at Brentford, while Newcastle hosted Chelsea, and Sheffield United faced fellow strugglers Bournemouth at Bramall Lane.

All the goals, drama and reaction from the day's five Premier League fixtures, including Newcastle United at home to under-pressure Manchester United. Newcastle took four points off Manchester United last season as both sides qualified for the Champions League, and they continue to impress, while the Red Devils have laboured.

eps.d: Live coverage as Michael Carrick's Middlesbrough aim to take scalp of Premier League high flyers Aston Villa in the third round of football's oldest cup competition.

eps.d: Join Gary Lineker and guests for comprehensive live coverage from the FA Cup third round as 14-time winners Arsenal take on title rivals and 2022 cup holders Liverpool.

Highlights of today's two Premier League games, with Newcastle hosting Manchester City and Chelsea taking on west London rivals Fulham. Newcastle beat Manchester City in the EFL Cup in September, but the Magpies are winless in the last nine league meetings between the two sides.

eps.t: The FA Cup Third Round Replay: Bristol City v West Ham United
eps.d: Coverage of the third-round replay, which takes place at Ashton Gate. The Championship outfit took a contingent of 9,000 fans to London Stadium for the original tie nine days ago, and put in a stirring performance to come back from a goal down to secure a 1-1 draw and earn tonight's replay.

Highlights and reaction from the day's two Premier League games as title-chasing Arsenal host Crystal Palace and Brentford take on Nottingham Forest. Arsenal had their Premier League winter break last weekend when many of the other title hopefuls were in action.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fourth Round: Ipswich Town v Maidstone United
eps.d: All the action from the fourth-round tie at Portman Road. National League South outfit Maidstone are the lowest-ranked team left in the competition, but claimed the scalp of a Football League outfit in the previous round when they overcame Stevenage 1-0.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fourth Round: Highlights
eps.d: Highlights of the latest fourth-round ties, including Ipswich Town v Maidstone United at Portman Road and Fulham v Newcastle United at Craven Cottage. Maidstone were the lowest-ranked side left in the competition and their reward for defeating League One Stevenage was a trip to Championship promotion-chasers Ipswich.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fourth Round: Newport County v Manchester United
eps.d: Coverage of the fourth-round tie, held at Rodney Parade. Newport earned this plum draw by defeating non-league Eastleigh after a replay and will now aim to cause a major upset against the 12-time cup-winners, who prevailed 2-0 away to Wigan Athletic in the previous round thanks to goals by Portuguese duo Diego Dalot and Bruno Fernandes.

Highlights from the midweek Premier League fixtures, including Liverpool against Chelsea at Anfield and Arsenal's trip to face Nottingham Forest. Elsewhere, Aston Villa entertain Newcastle United and Tottenham Hotspur host Brentford.

Gary Lineker presents highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Everton v Tottenham Hotspur at Goodison Park and Sheffield United v Aston Villa at Bramall Lane. Spurs and Villa are both fighting for places in the top four, while Everton and the Blades are involved in a relegation battle.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fourth Round Replay: Plymouth Argyle v Leeds United
eps.d: All the action from the fourth-round replay at Home Park, as the teams compete for the right to face Chelsea or Aston Villa in round five. Adam Rendell's 73rd-minute equaliser at Elland Road earned Plymouth a chance to progress on home territory, but Leeds will still be hopeful of reaching the fifth round given their stronger form in the Championship this term.

Gary Lineker and guests bring you all the goals, drama and reaction from a bumper day of Premier League action, featuring Tottenham's clash with fellow European hopefuls Brighton & Hove Albion. Brighton triumphed 4-2 in a thrilling contest when the two sides met earlier this season, although Tottenham have lost just once to the Seagulls at home in all competitions since 1981.

Gary Lineker presents highlights of the day's Premier League matches, featuring all the main title contenders. Reigning champions Manchester City host Chelsea, with neutrals hoping for a repeat of the 4-4 thriller that took place at Stamford Bridge in November. Liverpool visit Brentford, while Arsenal make the trip north to face struggling Burnley.

Gary Lineker presents highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Manchester v Fulham at Old Trafford, and Arsenal v Newcastle United at Emirates Stadium. eps.t: The FA Cup Fifth Round: Blackburn Rovers v Newcastle United
eps.d: Gary Lineker is joined in the studio at Ewood Park by former Blackburn and Newcastle legend Alan Shearer as the two sides meet in the FA Cup for the ninth time in 29 years. Newcastle have advanced from all five ties against Rovers during that period, although three went to a replay - including the most recent meeting, which the Magpies won 4-2 away after extra time in the 2018-19 third round.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fifth Round: Nottingham Forest v Manchester United
eps.d: Twelve-time FA Cup winners and last year's beaten finalists, Manchester United, face a tricky trip to Forest, who beat them in the league at the County Ground at the end of December. That 2-1 victory ended a run of 11 straight defeats for Nottingham Forest against the Red Devils, which included two Premier League encounters and the two-legged EFL Cup semi-final in 2023.

Gary Lineker presents highlights and analysis from all the day's seven Premier League matches, which have a big impact on both the top and bottom of the table. Liverpool travel to Nottingham Forest, looking to record their first away league win against them since 1984. Jurgen Klopp's side lost 1-0 at the City Ground last season, with Forest's former player Taiwo Awoniyi scoring the only goal.

Gary Lineker introduces all the goals, drama and expert analysis from the day's five Premier League fixtures. Title hopefuls Arsenal welcome London neighbours Brentford to the Emirates in the pick of the games, with the visitors seeking their first away win in this fixture for almost 86 years.

eps.t: The FA Cup Quarter-Final: Manchester City v Newcastle United
eps.d: Gary Lineker presents live coverage of the FA Cup quarter-final between holders Manchester City and Newcastle United, with a place in one of the two Wembley semi-finals just 90 minutes away.

All the goals, drama and expert analysis from the day's three fixtures in the Premier League, including two huge matches between four teams at the foot of the table. Luton welcome fellow strugglers Nottingham Forest to Kenilworth Road, with both sides desperate for three points in their battle for survival.

eps.t: The FA Cup Quarter-Final: Chelsea v Leicester City
eps.d: Gary Lineker presents live coverage from the FA Cup quarter-final between Chelsea and Leicester City in a rematch of the 2021 final in which the Blues were stunned by the Foxes.
Highlights of the weekend's quarter-final matches in the FA Cup.

Catch up on all the goals and talking points from a bumper round of midweek Premier League games, including critical matches at both ends of the table. Arsenal are aiming to further their title ambitions at home to Luton Town, while reigning champions and rivals Manchester City face Aston Villa. Elsewhere, struggling Burnley host Wolves and Everton travel to Newcastle United.

Gary Lineker and guests present all the highlights, drama and analysis from a busy day in the Premier League. Title hopefuls Manchester City and Arsenal are both in action, with City travelling to the capital to take on Crystal Palace in the lunchtime fixture, while Mikel Arteta's side make the trip to Brighton in the late kick-off.

Join Gary Lineker for all the goals, drama and analysis from the day's six Premier League games, including treble-chasing Manchester City at home to relegation-threatened Luton. Pep Guardiola's City have won twice away at Luton this season, in the Premier League and the FA Cup, with Erling Haaland scoring five goals in the latter meeting.

eps.t: The FA Cup Semi-Final: Manchester City v Chelsea
eps.d: Gary Lineker hosts live coverage of the FA Cup semi-final between holders Manchester City and eight-time winners Chelsea at Wembley, with a place in the 143rd FA Cup final at stake.

Relive all the goals, drama and analysis from the day's three Premier League games, including title-chasing Arsenal's visit to Wolverhampton Wanderers. The Gunners have won their last five Premier League clashes against Wolves, including a 2-0 victory at Molineux last season after a brace from Martin Odegaard.

Relive all the goals, drama and analysis from the day's three Premier League games, including title-chasing Arsenal's visit to Wolverhampton Wanderers. The Gunners have won their last five Premier League clashes against Wolves, including a 2-0 victory at Molineux last season after a brace from Martin Odegaard.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights of the day's seven Premier League matches, including title-chasing Liverpool's game away to West Ham. The Merseysiders have won nine of the last ten meetings between the two teams in all competitions, including a 3-1 victory at Anfield in the reverse league fixture.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights of the day's six Premier League matches, including title-chasing Arsenal's match at home to Bournemouth. In this fixture at the Emirates Stadium last season, the Gunners came from 2-0 down to stun the Cherries, thanks to a brilliant winner from Reiss Nelson in the 97th minute.

Gary Lineker presents highlights from all the day's fixtures on the penultimate weekend of Premier League action, which includes Manchester City's trip to Fulham. City, who have been involved in one of the most exciting title races in years, thrashed Fulham 5-1 at the Etihad earlier this season and will be looking for another three points today.

Gary Lineker presents a bumper edition of Match of the Day as all 20 teams meet on the final day of the 2023/24 Premier League season. This campaign has been thrilling at both ends of the table, with a host of teams battling it out for the title and fighting to avoid relegation.

eps.t: The FA Cup 2023/24 Final: Manchester City v Manchester United
eps.d: Gary Lineker hosts live coverage of the FA Cup final between holders Manchester City and twelve-time winners Manchester United at Wembley. This is the first time since 1885 that the FA Cup final will be contested by the same two clubs in consecutive years.

eps.t: The FA Cup 2023/24 Final Highlights: Manchester City v Manchester United
eps.d: Another chance to see the best of the action from the 2024 FA Cup final between local rivals Manchester City and Manchester United. The two sides are contesting the final of English football's showpiece club competition for a second successive season, with City victorious 12 months ago thanks to a 2-1 win.

Germany v Scotland. Alex Scott presents action from the Group A match at Munich Football Arena, as the tournament got under way. The hosts are looking to emulate their last triumph in this tournament at Euro 96, while Scotland are aiming to progress beyond the group stage of a major tournament for the first time.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Italy v Albania
eps.d: Coverage of the Group B match from BVB Stadion Dortmund, as the current holders play their first match of the competition. Italy finished second in their qualifying group behind England, after losing both of their matches against Gareth Southgate's side. They will be looking to become the first country since Spain in 2012 to successfully defend the title, and start as clear favourites here.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Poland v Netherlands
eps.d: Mark Chapman presents coverage of the Group D match from Volksparkstadion Hamburg. The Netherlands will be looking to improve on a disappointing recent record in Euros finals, having not made it past the quarter-finals since 2004. In 2021, they sailed through their group, finishing top with three wins out of three and scoring eight goals in the process, only to lose to Czechia 2-0 in the last 16.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Serbia v England
eps.d: Coverage of the Group C match from Arena AufSchalke in Gelsenkirchen, as Gareth Southgate's men kick off their tournament. The Three Lions famously finished runners-up at the previous finals, losing on penalties to Italy in the showpiece match, despite taking an early lead through a Luke Shaw goal.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Romania v Ukraine
eps.d: Mark Chapman presents coverage of the Group E match from Munich Football Arena. Romania finished top of their qualifying group ahead of the likes of Switzerland and Israel to make it to this tournament, and are playing in the finals for the first time since 2016.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Turkiye v Georgia
